title: Provider capabilities
description: What each workspace provider can do. Requests that need a missing capability are rejected with UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY rather than approximated.

isolation.description: Boundary between a workspace and its host.

suspend.description: Can release compute while keeping restoration state (`suspend`).

restore.description: Where a suspended workspace can be restored.

approvals_survive_restore.description: Pending runtime approvals stay decidable across restoration. When false they expire as `runtime_generation_changed`.
